written: 2026-10-03, after the build was parked at the operator's request
how: On the operator's go, the orchestrator launches every lane below in one message: Workflow({ scriptPath: "E:/Matter Of Place/.claude/workflows/build-slice.js", args: <lane.args> }). Before that: git -C <root> fetch origin && git -C <root> merge origin/main in each lane (the builders also do it at every group). The board at http://127.0.0.1:8790 shows the lanes live (node workspace/05-plans/board.mjs). First thing after launch, run the plan audits of ruling H50 item 1 as read-only Opus agents over B1b, B2, B4, B3, B3b and B9.

lanes.name: spine
lanes.note: B1b steps 7 to 11. Step 7's additions by ruling H49 were being built when the run was stopped; the WIP commit 88994da on slice/b1b holds them unproven. Item (3) of H49, the test timeouts and worker cap, is already on main (package.json test script), so the close-out carries two items. Bank numbers from P-150 and G-40: without a base this lane continued from the highest number in the file and collided with the orchestrator's P-502 (P-503 on main).

closeOut.title: B1b step 7: finish the WIP of ruling H49 (production switch, rollback target); the test timeouts are on main already

defects.what: Finish the work saved in commit 88994da (WIP, parked), do not start over. Ruling ASSUMED H49 (1): the `production` job runs only when the repository variable PRODUCTION_DEPLOY is `on` (it is `off` today; the orchestrator sets it to `on` when B3b is on main). Add `&& vars.PRODUCTION_DEPLOY == 'on'` to its `if:`, a hygiene test case for it, watched failing, with a registry entry. The first production deploy and every live production proof of step 7 are NOT DONE until then; say so in the log.
defects.evidence: gh variable list shows PRODUCTION_DEPLOY off; ASSUMED.md row H49.

defects.what: Ruling H49 (2): before `wrangler deploy`, the dev job reads the version id serving 100 percent into a step output (empty when the Worker does not exist yet); after a red smoke it runs `wrangler rollback <that id> --yes` and prints `rolled back to <id>`, or prints `first deploy: nothing to roll back to` and exits 1. Keep the hygiene cases in step, watched failing. Then `bun run check`, `bun run build`, commit, push slice/b1b.
defects.evidence: deploy.yml before the WIP: deploy, then `wrangler secret bulk`, then smoke, then `wrangler rollback` with no version id.
